_note: English texts for the front page.
meta.title: Vaateta — Kids' clothes without hours of browsing
meta.description: Tell us what your child needs. Vaateta finds the best picks from Nordic online shops and shows why each one fits.
lang.label: Language
hero.title:
Kids' clothes,
without scrolling
all evening.
hero.lede: Tell us in one sentence what your child needs. Vaateta compares online shops and shows the best fits – you choose.
search.label: What does your child need?
steps.title: How it works
steps.1.title: Say what you need
steps.1.text: Type or say it in your own words: item, size or age, and budget.
steps.2.title: Vaateta compares
steps.2.text: We find matching products across several shops. Sold-out items are left out.
steps.3.title: You choose
steps.3.text: See why each item fits, then buy directly from the shop.
results.title: Results
results.hint: Includes Outnorth (Finland and Sweden) and Voghion. Prices update once a day.
results.understood: Here's how I read your search
empty.title: We haven’t found matching products yet
empty.msg: Only a few shops are included so far. Try another search or one of these:
tabs.label: Sort results
about.title: About
about.why.title: Why Vaateta
about.why.text: Shopping for kids' clothes means sizes, prices and deals scattered across dozens of tabs. Vaateta brings the right options together in one search.
about.shops.title: Shops included
about.shops.more: More kids' clothing shops are on the way.
about.funding.title: How Vaateta is funded
about.funding.text: If you buy through a Vaateta link, the shop may pay us a small commission. It doesn't raise your price or affect the order of results.
cta.title: Something missing?
cta.text: Tell us what you're looking for or what didn't work. We read every message.
footer.fineprint: Prices and availability update once a day, so check the final price in the shop. Product links are affiliate links. The front-page image was created with AI.
voice.title: Speak now
voice.prompt: Tell me what your child needs.
voice.example: E.g. “winter jacket for a 6-year-old, max 80 euros”
